gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
The old theatre is ___ threat of demolition.
The soldiers were ___ of danger once they had crossed the river.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of danger' = no longer at risk.

gaps.sentence: He stayed ___ touch with every colleague he'd ever had.
The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: The museum is open to the public ___ appointment only.
___ reference to your letter of 12 May, we are still processing the claim.
gaps.explanation: 'With reference to' introduces the subject of a formal letter.

gaps.sentence: The manuscript came ___ light during the clearance of the archive.
gaps.explanation: 'Come to light' = become known or be discovered.
